quantize_model_with_autoround: create an AutoRound instance and call quantize to quantize a model with specified bits and group_size
quantize_and_save_model: build an AutoRound quantization pipeline that quantizes a model and saves it to a directory in auto_round format
configure_layer_wise_quantization: create an AutoRound instance with layer_config to set per-layer bits and data_type for selective quantization
quantize_with_mx_fp4: run AutoRound quantization using mx_fp4 data_type with act_bits and act_data_type for mixed precision quantization
dequantize_fp8_weight: test the _dequant_fp8_linear_weight utility to dequantize FP8 linear weights back to high precision
